data.name: Hurayah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-r-y, Hurayah refers to freedom, liberation and liberty. The name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Anfal, Verse 46, when Allah (SWT) grants the believers the freedom to fight against their enemies. Thus, Hurayah signifies the spirit of courage, bravery and resistance in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of courage and resistance in the face of adversity.
